title: Try it in two chats
lead: Tap Next. The left phone is Telegram. The right phone is Delta Chat. Same moment on both sides.

scenes.caption: Open the portal bot in a private Telegram chat and send /start.
The bot answers with a Delta Chat invite and a short pairing code (about 30 minutes).

bubbles.text:
Open this Delta Chat invite, then send only this code:
K7H2MQNP

scenes.caption: Open the invite in Delta Chat / ArcaneChat. You now have a 1:1 with the TGPORTAL bot.

bubbles.text:
Open this Delta Chat invite, then send only this code:
K7H2MQNP
Chat accepted. Send the pairing code.

scenes.caption: In that Delta Chat, send only the code. The pair becomes active.

bubbles.text: Paired. Stickers and text now go both ways.

scenes.caption: Send a sticker on Telegram. It lands in the same Delta Chat, no noisy filename.
Persona needs you already paired (story 1). Then create a bot with BotFather and copy the token. Never paste it in public chats.

bubbles.text: You are already paired. Ghosts can reach you.

scenes.caption: On the portal bot (private chat), register that token. This is /pair-bot — not the same as /pair.
TGPORTAL starts polling your bot. The token stays in SQLite under ./data on the host.

bubbles.text: Persona bot @YourBot is polling. Anyone who DMs it gets a ghost.
No extra invite. Your public key is already stored.

scenes.caption: On the server you also set PERSONA_ACCOUNT_QR so new ghosts can be created. mode: persona or both.
Alice never opens Delta Chat. She only DMs your BotFather bot.
TGPORTAL creates (or reuses) a ghost Delta Chat account with Alice’s name and photo. It messages you as a normal 1:1.
You reply in Delta Chat as you always do. No “via Telegram” label.
The reply leaves Telegram as your bot. Telegram cannot puppet Alice. Bob would be a different ghost, a different chat.
